coordinating and evaluating the performance of all of these devices to forecast and estimate the delivered grid value requires state\-of\-the\-art data science, control systems and machine learning. as such, energyhub seeks to hire an energy data scientist to join energyhub's analytics engineering team. as an energy data scientist you will work closely with other data scientists and analytics engineers to improve the models used for evaluation of our control algorithms. you will collaborate with the data science and power systems intelligence team to understand the algorithms and optimizations used in order to improve our performance evaluation and forecasting abilities. you will also contribute to our data management software systems and will become core to the foundation of a future with carbon\-free and distributed energy.


**what you will do:**


* you will drive the development of m\&v methodologies and data science models for more accurate and transparent evaluation of our advanced grid services from fleets of distributed energy resources.
* you will write production\-level code, prototype new data products, and apply machine learning algorithms to energy iot data
* you will work to translate data from one of the largest distributed energy datasets in the electricity industry into actionable insights for electric utilities and other energy industry stakeholders
* you will collaborate closely with stakeholders inside and outside of energyhub including data engineering, client success, marketing, sales, product, and market development teams.
* other duties as assigned


**who you are:**


* you are passionate about enabling a carbon\-free, distributed energy future
* you thoroughly enjoy finding valuable insights in large, complex datasets
* you have experience with python and the scientific stack (pandas, numpy, scipy)
* you have proficiency in sql and understand good data modeling practices (basic etl/elt)
* you have a practical comprehension of basic machine learning algorithms and are familiar with popular software packages such as sklearn and tensorflow.
* you can explain results from large\-scale data analyses to diverse audiences in a way that is clear, interesting and actionable
* you can have fun while working on really hard problems with really smart people


**bonus points if:**


* you have experience in the measurement and verification (m\&v) of control and optimization of distributed energy resources
* you have experience in using snowflake, dbt and understanding analytics engineering development practices
* you have experience with at least one bi tool such as sigma, tableau, looker, etc)
* you have experience with scaling data science products in the cloud (e.g., databricks, aws, gcp, azure)
* you have a strong background in mathematics and statistics
* you have power systems expertise, including three\-phase distribution network modeling


please note that sponsorship of new applicants for employment authorization, or any other immigration\-related support, is not available for this position at this time.


**why work for energyhub?**


* **collaborate with outstanding people:** our employees work hard, do great work, and enjoy collaborating and learning from each other.
* **make an immediate impact:** new employees can expect to be given real responsibility for bringing new technologies to the marketplace. you are empowered to perform as soon as you join the team!
* **gain well rounded experience:** energyhub offers a diverse and dynamic environment where you will get the chance to work directly with executives and develop expertise across multiple areas of the business.
* **work with the latest technologies:** you'll gain exposure to a broad spectrum of iot, saas and machine learning obstacles, including distributed fault\-tolerance, device control optimization, and process modeling to support scalable interaction with disparate downstream apis.
* **be part of something important:** help create the future of how energy is produced and consumed. make a positive impact on our climate.


**about energyhub**



energyhub empowers utilities and their customers to create a clean, distributed energy future. we help consumers turn their smart thermostats, evs, batteries, and other products into virtual power plants that keep the grid stable and enable higher penetration of solar and wind power.



to learn more, visit energyhub.com.


**company benefits**



energyhub offers a generous benefits package including 100% paid medical for employees and a 401(k) with employer match. we offer a casual environment, the flexibility to set your own schedule, a fully stocked fridge and pantry, free citi bike membership, secure bike rack, gym subsidy, paid parental leave, and an education assistance program.


**energyhub is an equal opportunity employer**



eoe, including disability/vets. reasonable accommodations are available for individuals with disabilities throughout the application process. if you are a person with a disability needing assistance with the application process, please contact accommodations.apply@energyhub.net.

title: Conversational AI/ Chatbot Developer
description:
**conversational ai / chatbot developer**
=========================================


**diverse agile solutions, llc (das)** is seeking an experienced **conversational ai / chatbot developer** to support an enterprise client and help design, develop, integrate, and optimize next\-generation conversational ai experiences.


this is an exciting opportunity for a developer who enjoys working at the intersection of **traditional conversational ai, generative ai, and autonomous ai agents**. the ideal candidate will have strong microsoft azure conversational technology experience and be comfortable integrating ai solutions with enterprise platforms such as salesforce and peoplesoft.


**what you'll do**
------------------


* design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain enterprise chatbots, virtual assistants, and ai agents.
* develop and maintain conversational applications using **azure bot framework sdk v4**.
* build conversational workflows using **waterfall dialogs, custom middleware, and state management**.
* help modernize existing chatbot capabilities using **azure ai foundry, microsoft copilot studio, and microsoft agents 365 / microsoft 365 agents sdk technologies**.
* integrate conversational applications with enterprise systems using **mulesoft, rest apis, salesforce, and peoplesoft**.
* develop **salesforce live chat and case management** integrations for human\-agent escalation and automated case routing.
* build rich conversational experiences using **adaptive cards** across web, mobile, and messaging channels.
* integrate **azure conversational language understanding (clu)** with **azure openai/gpt** to support intent recognition, routing, fallback handling, and contextual responses.
* develop and optimize **rag and llm\-based solutions**.
* monitor conversation logs, intent accuracy, containment rates, and other performance metrics to continuously improve the user experience.
* use tools such as **azure application insights and power bi** to analyze conversational performance.
* work with product managers, ux designers, developers, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into effective conversational experiences.
* participate in agile development, testing, code reviews, and ci/cd activities.

**required qualifications**
---------------------------


* **3\+ years of software development experience** with a focus on conversational ai, nlp/nlu, chatbots, or llm/ai agent development.
* hands\-on experience with **azure bot framework sdk v4**.
* experience with **waterfall dialogs, custom middleware, and conversation state management**.
* strong programming experience with **c\# and .net**.
* experience with **javascript**, html, and css.
* experience with **azure openai and/or generative ai technologies**.
* experience with **azure clu or other nlu technologies**.
* experience integrating enterprise applications through **rest apis and/or mulesoft**.
* experience with **salesforce and/or peoplesoft integrations**.
* strong understanding of conversational design, apis, enterprise integration, and cloud\-based application development.
* excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

**preferred qualifications**
----------------------------


* experience with **azure ai foundry**.
* experience with **microsoft copilot studio**.
* experience with **microsoft agents 365 / microsoft 365 agents sdk**.
* experience developing **adaptive cards**.
* salesforce **live chat and case management** integration experience.
* experience with **azure cosmos db** for conversation state and user context.
* experience with **azure application insights** and **power bi**.
* experience developing **rag/llm orchestration** solutions.
* experience building or maintaining **ci/cd pipelines** using azure devops, github actions, or similar tools.
* experience working in **higher education or other complex enterprise environments**.
* experience with agentic ai and autonomous ai architectures.

**why join das?**
-----------------


at **diverse agile solutions**, you'll work on challenging technology initiatives involving **artificial intelligence, cloud, devsecops, cybersecurity, agile transformation, and enterprise it modernization**.


we are a growing technology services company that values technical excellence, collaboration, accountability, and professional growth.


**position details**
--------------------


**position:** conversational ai / chatbot developer  

**company:** diverse agile solutions, llc  

**employment type:** contract  

**work arrangement:** \[remote potential depending on candidate]  

**location:** adelphi, md  

**duration:** initially 6 month with possible extension  

**compensation:** $85,000 \- $90,000


### **how to apply**


if you're an experienced conversational ai developer who is excited about combining **azure, generative ai, enterprise integrations, and next\-generation ai agents**, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Integrations - AI/ML
description:
### **about clickhouse**


recognized on the 2025 forbes cloud 100 list, clickhouse is one of the most innovative and fast\-growing private cloud companies. with more than 4,000 customers and arr that has grown over 250 percent year over year, clickhouse leads the market in real\-time analytics, data warehousing, observability, and ai workloads.


the company’s sustained, accelerating momentum was recently validated by a $400m series d financing round. over the past three months, customers including capital one, lovable, decagon, polymarket, and airwallex have adopted the platform or expanded existing deployments. these customers join an established base of ai innovators and global brands such as meta, cursor, sony, and tesla.


we’re on a mission to transform how companies use data. come be a part of our journey!


the connectors team is the bridge between clickhouse and the broader ecosystem. we build and maintain the integrations that make clickhouse accessible to millions of developers, data practitioners, and ai agents worldwide, from high\-level data visualization plugins (tableau, powerbi, superset, metabase) to connectors for data frameworks (apache spark, flink, kafka connect, fivetran), orchestration platforms, and ai tooling.


our work directly shapes how companies process massive datasets: real\-time analytics platforms that ingest millions of events per second, observability systems that monitor global infrastructure, and, increasingly, ai\-powered data applications that redefine how teams work with data. we collaborate closely with the open\-source community, internal teams, and enterprise users to ensure clickhouse integrations set the standard for performance, reliability, and developer experience.


### **about the role**


as a **senior software engineer specializing in the ai \& ml ecosystem**, you'll be a core contributor owning and evolving critical parts of clickhouse's ai ecosystem. this role sits at the intersection of high\-performance database engineering and developer experience. you'll craft tools that enable engineers and data scientists to harness clickhouse's speed and scale in the frameworks they already use.


we're looking for someone who has firsthand experience as an ai \& mlengineer or data scientist. the data practitioner's world is shifting rapidly: databases are no longer just query targets, but they're becoming active participants in ai\-powered workflows, serving as vector stores for rag pipelines, backends for llm\-powered agents, and real\-time feature stores for ml inference. you understand these workflows not from the outside, but because you've operated within them. you don't just build integrations, you bring product\-level insight into what we should build and why.


you'll own the full lifecycle of key ai/ml integrations, driving architecture, performance, and feature direction across **ai \& llm ecosystem:** langchain, llamaindex, n8n, and broader ai tooling: embedding pipelines, retrieval\-augmented generation with clickhouse as a vector store, ml feature stores, and llm\-powered data applications.


clickhouse's columnar architecture and query performance make it exceptionally well\-positioned in this new landscape. your job is to make that potential real: building the robust, production\-ready connectors that make clickhouse the natural choice when data practitioners design their next\-generation ai and data systems.


### **what you'll do**


* own and evolve clickhouse's python connector and sdk ecosystem, raising the bar on performance, reliability, and api design
* drive the ai/llm integration strategy: designing connectors and patterns that make clickhouse a natural fit in rag architectures, ml feature pipelines, and llm\-powered data applications
* engage actively with the open\-source community: triage issues, support contributors, advocate for users, and shape the roadmap based on real\-world feedback
* collaborate with product, cloud, and other engineering teams to align integration work with broader platform priorities
* bring a practitioner's perspective to roadmap decisions, grounding prioritization in genuine data engineer and data scientist workflows

### **about you**


* 7\+ years of software development experience, including hands\-on time as a data scientist or ml engineer
* deep, proven experience designing, building, and maintaining production\-grade python connectors, sdks, or integrations for at least one major platform (orchestration, bi, mlops, or data transformation)
* hands\-on experience applying ai/ml in production data\-engineering contexts: embedding generation, vector search, feature pipelines, or llm\-powered tooling that shipped and ran in production
* solid experience with the python data ecosystem: pandas, numpy, pydantic, and related libraries
* strong database fundamentals: sql, data modeling, query optimization, and familiarity with olap/analytical databases
* solid experience with concurrent python: threading, multiprocessing, and async patterns
* outstanding written and verbal communication; comfortable collaborating across engineering functions and with open\-source communities

**bonus points for:**


* prior experience as a data engineer or data scientist in a product\-facing or platform role
* familiarity with clickhouse or similar high\-performance olap platforms
* familiarity with the jvm ecosystem
* experience deploying ai/ml models in production, including inference apis and vector databases
* familiarity with tools like dbt, airflow, dagster, prefect is a plus

$141,000 \- $208,000 usd


the typical starting salary for this role in us premium markets is


$157,000 \- $232,000 usd

if you have any questions or comments about compensation as a candidate, please get in touch with us at paytransparency@clickhouse.com.


### **perks**


* **flexible work environment** \- clickhouse is a globally distributed company and remote\-friendly. we currently operate in over 20 countries.
* **healthcare** \- employer contributions towards your healthcare.
* **equity in the company** \- every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.
* **time off** \- flexible time off in the us, generous entitlement in other countries.
* **a $500 home office setup** if you’re a remote employee.
* **global gatherings** – we believe in the power of in\-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company\-wide offsites.

**culture \- we all shape it**


as part of a rapidly scaling start up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.


are you interested in finding out more about our culture? check out our blog posts or follow us on linkedin to find out more about what’s happening at clickhouse.


**equal opportunity \& privacy**

job category


software engineering
job details


**about salesforce**

salesforce is the \#1 ai crm, where humans with agents drive customer success together. here, ambition meets action. tech meets trust. and innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. the world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through ai, driving innovation, and keeping salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.


ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? you’re in the right place! agentforce is the future of ai, and you are the future of salesforce.


the experience \& impact  



  

agents and ai are fast\-evolving technologies. the digital success engineering team within digital experience technology is building agentforce\-powered ai agents that handle customer support inquiries autonomously — resolving routine questions, deflecting cases, and delivering live chat support at scale. our implementations have already cut $100m in support costs , handled 3\+ million customer conversations , and enabled salesforce to offer 24/7 multilingual support in 7 languages — something never achieved before in its 27\-year history.


as customer zero for agentforce , we are at the absolute bleeding edge of autonomous agent development, pioneering architectural patterns that shape how global enterprises deploy ai. we are looking for an ai software engineer (member of technical staff) who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, delivers incrementally, and thinks creatively. you will build cutting\-edge agent technologies using agentforce, agent script, salesforce crm, and data cloud .


what you’ll be doing


* agent architecture \& development: design, build, and optimize enterprise\-grade ai agents using agentforce builder , agent script , and new graph architecture (nga) .
* autonomous conversation design: develop agent topics, reasoning paths, skills, and fallback flows to deliver rich, multi\-turn, multilingual support experiences.
* prompt engineering \& fine\-tuning: craft, evaluate, and iterate on system prompts, guardrails, and contextual instructions (using techniques like few\-shot learning and chain\-of\-thought) to maximize response accuracy, safety, and operational efficiency.
* integrations \& data pipelines: build robust integrations connecting ai agents to salesforce data cloud , apex, rest/graphql apis, and external enterprise systems to fuel agents with real\-time context.
* model evaluation \& quality assurance: implement testing frameworks, a/b testing, and benchmarking to measure conversation quality, deflection accuracy, hallucination rates, and semantic search precision.
* customer zero innovation: partner with product management, architects, and ai researchers to test unreleased agentforce capabilities internally, feeding critical insights back into core platform product roadmaps.
* production excellence: participate in agile release cycles, contribute to ci/cd pipelines, conduct code reviews, and join on\-call rotations to ensure high availability and sub\-second response times for global, multi\-tenant operations.

required skills \& qualifications


* education: bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* experience level:
* mts: 3–5\+ years of software engineering experience with strong backend development exposure including demonstrated experience designing and scaling ai/ml services or conversational ai systems.
* core software engineering: strong hands\-on proficiency in object\-oriented/statically typed languages ( java , python , apex , or c\# ) within microservice, multi\-tenant saas environments.
* applied generative ai \& nlp: solid understanding of large language models (llms), rag architectures, prompt engineering/optimization, embeddings, and vector databases.
* salesforce ecosystem: hands\-on experience or working familiarity with the salesforce platform (apex, lwc, flows, api integrations, agentforce).
* data integration \& apis: experience developing and consuming restful/graphql apis, managing data pipelines, and working with both relational and non\-relational database architectures.
* agile \& devops: familiarity with modern developer tools and practices (git, ci/cd, unit testing frameworks, automated e2e testing).
* communication \& collaboration: excellent problem\-solving skills and ability to translate complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders in a cross\-functional environment.

even better if you have (preferred qualifications)


* direct hands\-on experience with salesforce agentforce , agent script , or data cloud .
* prior background building customer service bots, autonomous agents, or multi\-agent orchestration frameworks at scale.
* deep experience with evaluation techniques for genai, including rlhf, bias mitigation, and safety guardrailing.
* salesforce certifications (e.g., *platform app builder* , *salesforce developer* , or *ai associate/specialist* ).

unleash your potential


when you join salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our ai agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . together, we’ll bring the power of agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for ai, and the world.

title: AI & Data Architect, US
description:
role overview


as an ai \& data architect, you will define the technical architecture for large\-scale ai and data platforms that power both oci services and ai\-enabled experiences across oracle products. you will establish reference architectures, canonical apis, integration patterns, and platform primitives that product teams can build on rather than recreate independently.


you will work across distributed cloud infrastructure, ai systems, databases, data engineering, search, enterprise applications, networking, security, and developer platforms. the role requires strong systems thinking, deep software and data architecture experience, practical knowledge of modern ai systems, and the ability to influence technical direction across multiple engineering organizations without relying on organizational authority.


oracle product \& platform scope


the architecture is expected to span oci and the broader oracle portfolio. representative platforms include:


**architecture layer**

**representative oracle platforms / capabilities**

  

**ai \& agent platform**

oci generative ai (responses api, hosted agentic applications, and agents/rag); oci data science; oci ai services (language, speech, vision, and document understanding).  



  

**database, data \& retrieval**

oracle ai database 26ai / autonomous ai database; ai vector search; select ai / nl2sql; oracle ai data platform; goldengate; object storage, streaming, data integration, data flow, and opensearch.  



  

**applications \& analytics**

fusion cloud applications; ai agent studio / fusion agentic applications; oracle analytics cloud / fusion data intelligence; oracle integration; oracle apex.  



  

**cross\-oracle consumers**

reusable capabilities for oracle saas and industry products, netsuite, oracle health, partner solutions, and customer applications.


  



*this list is representative, not exhaustive; the role is expected to create reusable architecture across product boundaries, not own every product implementation*


  
what you'll do


* define long\-term architecture and technical strategy for oracle\-wide ai and data platform capabilities, with oci as the core cloud foundation and clean integration into oracle database, applications, analytics, and integration products.
* design scalable platform architectures for generative ai, agentic ai, classical machine learning, structured and unstructured data, enterprise search, knowledge systems, and conversational data access.
* architect systems for:

– foundation\-model access, model routing, inference, embeddings, reranking, fine\-tuning, prompt/context management, and model lifecycle.


– agent runtimes, multi\-agent orchestration, planning, memory, tool execution, workflow integration, human approvals, and secure delegation.


– retrieval\-augmented generation (rag), knowledge bases, semantic and hybrid search, query rewriting, reranking, grounding, provenance, and citations.


– enterprise knowledge management including ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata, taxonomy, ontology, business glossary, lifecycle, and entitlement\-aware retrieval.


– nl2sql and conversational analytics, including schema/semantic grounding, metadata enrichment, sql generation and validation, permission\-aware execution, and natural\-language narration of results.


– ai\-ready data platforms supporting batch, streaming, change data capture, lakehouse patterns, data products, feature/embedding generation, and low\-latency serving.


– ai evaluation and observability covering quality, hallucination/grounding, retrieval relevance, tool\-call success, agent completion, latency, reliability, safety, and cost.

title: Software Engineer - CHG (Hybrid)
description:
**the application window is expected to close on:** 09/29/2026
  
meet the team
  
  

we are cisco secure common services platform engineering, part of cisco's security business group, anchoring the platform that helps protect the world's most critical infrastructure by building the foundational building blocks powering every product across cisco security cloud. our services — common provisioning, identity and access management, common objects service, posture service, and policy service — give cisco's security products a shared language for security objects, posture, and policy, moving the portfolio toward unified policy outcomes instead of fragmented, one\-off integrations; when we ship a cleaner object model or a faster policy api, every downstream team that depends on it moves faster too. we're a small, close\-knit engineering team working across go microservices, event\-driven kafka pipelines, and kubernetes/eks infrastructure, where engineers own problems end\-to\-end, value transparency, and lean on each other rather than staying siloed. it's an exciting time to join: we're pushing ai/ml deeper into how we design, build, and ship the platform, while tackling real distributed\-systems challenges — multi\-tenant isolation, cycle\-safe hierarchy resolution, high\-throughput event distribution — that shape how securely and smoothly cisco's entire security portfolio works together.
  
  

your impact
  
  

* design and build core components of the common services platform and/or solutions to enable scalable, secure, and resilient cloud\-native deployments.
* partner with product management to understand requirements, estimate level of effort, and contribute to sprint and quarterly planning.
* collaborate across teams to deliver end\-to\-end functionality while aligning on integration points and infrastructure.
* develop pocs and prototypes to explore new ideas, validate technical approaches, or test performance.
* mentor peers and engineering interns, sharing best practices and supporting their growth.
* contribute to system design and implementation to ensure high\-quality, timely delivery.


minimum qualifications
  
  

* bachelors \+ 5 years of related experience or masters \+ 3 years of related experience or phd \+ 0 years of designing, developing, and deploying enterprise software in production environments.
* 3\+ years of experience developing, deploying, and managing large\-scale cloud\-native web applications and microservices using golang, terraform, and serverless technologies such as aws lambda, appsync, and ecs/eks
* 3\+ years of experience using sql (postgresql) and nosql (dynamodb) storage systems.
* 1\+ year of experience building event\-driven systems using message/streaming platforms such as kafka, sqs, or sns for asynchronous, service\-to\-service communication.
* experience using ai/ml tools or apis (e.g., llm\-based coding assistants, model apis, ml\-driven automation) to support software development workflows.


preferred qualifications
  
  

* exposure to data structures and algorithms beyond the basics — e.g., graph traversal, recursive or hierarchical data modeling — through coursework, side projects, or production work.
* experience with clean/layered service architectures (handler → service → repository) and orm frameworks such as gorm.
* experience taking difficult problems and translating them into solutions.
* ability to communicate clearly and summarize information to others concisely across cross\-functional and distributed teams.


why cisco?
  
  

at cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the ai era – and beyond. we’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. these solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. we work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
we are cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Full-Stack Engineer
description:
### **about onx**



we’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors. driven by our mission to awaken the adventurer inside everyone, we build products that optimize every outdoor experience and inspire confidence to get out and go further.



we’re a high\-growth tech company. the pace is fast, the work takes grit, and ambiguity is part of the job. as the world changes around us, we adapt \- continuously evolving how we build, prioritize, and deliver.



our business moves quickly, and there’s real opportunity to shape what we build next. each of our verticals \- hunt, offroad, backcountry, and fish \- is at a different stage of maturity, which means the challenges you encounter and the impact you have will vary depending on where you sit and what the business needs most.



we operate with an experimentation mindset, continually iterating and improving how we solve problems. we expect our people to use the latest tooling, including ai, thoughtfully and responsibly, pairing human judgment with technology to increase quality, speed, and impact.



our impact comes to life through the products we build, in the stories of our customers, and in our growing commitment to land stewardship and recreational access.

### **about this opportunity**



onx is seeking a **software development engineer** (full\-stack) to help build and evolve the technology that powers onx hunt. as part of the hunt team, you’ll work across the stack, with a particular focus on the services, apis, and data that connect to the experiences hunters rely on throughout their journey, from getting started with onx to planning and navigating their season.



you’ll solve technical problems that span systems and product experiences, contribute to architectural decisions, and partner closely with engineers and product managers across teams to build reliable, maintainable solutions that scale with hunt. this role reports to the engineering manager of hunt.


### **what you'll do**
***essential job duties \& functions***


* design, build, and evolve customer\-facing hunt experiences across mobile applications, apis, backend services, and data systems.
* own technical solutions from design through delivery, making sound decisions about architecture, performance, scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability.
* build and support large\-scale systems throughout their lifecycle, diagnosing complex technical issues and continuously improving the systems you own.
* partner with product, design, qa, and engineers across teams to deliver cohesive, high\-quality customer experiences and navigate cross\-team dependencies.
* write maintainable, well\-tested code and use unit, integration, and acceptance testing to ensure the reliability and performance of the systems you build.
* review code, share technical knowledge, and mentor and support other engineers in strengthening their craft.
* look for opportunities to embed ai as a repeatable co\-pilot in daily workflows by integrating experimentation into real work, and continuously refining its use with sound judgment and validation

### **what you’ll bring**


* bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, computer engineering, a related field, or equivalent experience.
* five (5\) or more years of professional software development experience is required, where api development was your professional focus for at least three (3\) or more years.
* experience building and debugging distributed, scalable microservices architectures.
* you are well\-versed in modern api and systems design and development, with a strong computer science foundation.
* experience with relational databases such as mysql and postgresql.
* experience working in go, elixir or other functional programming languages
* experience with ios or android development
* you evaluate technologies and solutions based on merit, stability, performance, and the ability to debug, and you write maintainable, well\-tested code that's easy for others to understand.
* a strong sense of ownership, a desire to mentor and be mentored, and advocacy for the customer and their experience.
* a strong curiosity for exploring new technologies, including ai.
* a shared passion for and ability to demonstrate onx's company values.
* you want to work with other happy, talented engineers.
* you write great code and get stuff done.
* permanent us work authorization is a condition of employment with onx.
* ability to travel on occasion for multiple days to a corporate office or other onx strategic location, such as a basecamp.

### **added bonuses**



though not required, we would be thrilled to consider candidates with any of the following:


* experience working with graphql.
* experience with python.
* familiarity with docker, kubernetes, and infrastructure\-as\-code technologies such as terraform.
* familiarity with at least one major cloud platform provider such as google cloud platform.
* experience with geospatial databases such as postgis.
* experience with cockroachdb distributed database systems.
* experience with event\-based workflows.
* experience working with a distributed team.

### **the onx experience**



onx is a distributed company with more than 400 employees across the country. we come together regularly to work in person and stay connected through regional basecamps and a culture that balances individual ownership with deep collaboration.



while we move quickly, we’re not a scrappy start\-up. we operate with clear goals, structure, and frameworks that guide how we prioritize and execute. priorities matter. while they may shift, data shapes how we evolve as our business, products, and the world around us change.



clear priorities and structure don’t limit ownership \- they make it possible. you’ll have the autonomy to define your work and make meaningful decisions within clear strategic boundaries. you’ll partner closely with others to solve complex problems and build solutions that scale across teams and platforms. along the way, you’ll be supported with feedback, tools, and opportunities to grow your craft as you take on new challenges.


### **where you can work**



onx has created a thriving distributed workforce designed to foster connection, collaboration, and shared experience across several us locations. we have two hq locations in bozeman and missoula, mt and established virtual workforce basecamps in austin, tx; denver, co; kalispell, mt; minneapolis, mn; portland, or; salt lake city, ut; and seattle, wa.


### **how you’ll be compensated**



 onx is committed to compensating all employees fairly and equitably for their contributions. for this position, applicants can expect to make between $130,000 and $153,000 upon hire. the pay range will vary based upon experience, skills, certifications, education among other factors as required in the job description. in addition, full\-time onx employees are eligible for a grant of common share options with a vesting schedule and an annual bonus of 10% based on company performance.


### **what we’re offering you**


* competitive salaries, annual bonuses, equity, and opportunities for growth
* comprehensive health benefits, including a no\-monthly\-cost medical plan
* paid parental leave of 13 weeks for birthing parents and 5 weeks for non\-birthing parents
* 401k matching at 100% for the first 3% you save and 50% from 3\-5%
* company\-wide outdoor adventures and amazing outdoor industry perks
* annual “get out, get active” funds to fuel your active lifestyle
* flexible time away package that includes pto, sto, vto, and paid holidays

### **performance essentials**



in this role, success is driven by cognitive abilities such as concentration and problem\-solving, essential for our computer\-centric tasks. onx will explore reasonable accommodations to ensure that individuals with diverse abilities can fully engage in and contribute to the essential physical and mental functions of the job. if you need assistance or accommodation, please contact us at pc@onxmaps.com.

title: Sr Cloud Engineer
description:
**cls generic position summary**


as a member of the professional staff, contributes specialized knowledge and skill in a discipline (e.g. accounting, finance, human resources, information technology, operations planning \& support, sales \& marketing) area to support team and/or department business objectives. generally works under limited supervision, but within established guidelines, producing and analyzing more complex business information to assist in the decision\-making process.

 **specific job summary**


the senior cloud engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting scalable automation and platform engineering capabilities that enable mvw’s global technology environment. this role develops and maintains infrastructure and platform services as code across mvw’s multi\-cloud ecosystem, including amazon web services (primary), microsoft azure, and oracle cloud infrastructure, while supporting the container, data, and integration platforms that operate within those environments, such as red hat openshift service on aws (rosa), oracle autonomous data warehouse (adw), and microsoft fabric.


working as a subject matter expert within global technology, the incumbent partners with infrastructure, security, application, data, and business teams to deliver reliable, secure, and cost\-effective cloud solutions. the role applies automation, ai\-enabled engineering practices, and disciplined governance to reduce operational complexity, improve self\-service capabilities, strengthen platform reliability, and accelerate technology delivery in alignment with mvw’s security, compliance, and ai governance standards.

 **cls generic expected contributions**

* performs more complex quantitative and qualitative analysis for business processes and/or projects. often manages small projects, business processes or parts of larger ones.
* responds to, solves, and makes decisions on more complex/non\-routine business requests with limited to moderate risk.
* responsible for own work and contributing to team, department and/or business results. may direct work of non\-management staff.

* demonstrates an awareness of personal strengths and areas for improvement and acts independently to improve and increase skills and knowledge.
* performs other duties as appropriate.

**working relationships**

* global technology teams and leadership
* regional and site leadership
* corporate leadership
* architecture
* information security
* network engineering
* data \& analytics and application development
* global technology services resort end user support teams
* vendors and cloud provider account teams.

**specific expected contributions**


cloud infrastructure \& automation

* design, build, and operate multi\-cloud infrastructure as code across aws, azure, and oci using terraform and ansible, authoring, versioning, and testing reusable modules and collections rather than only consuming them.
* automate landing zone, network, identity, and workload provisioning across dozens of environments from a single, auditable control plane, and enforce guardrails through policy as code (aws scps, azure policy, opa) so that compliance applies at deploy time rather than after the fact. partner with network and information security on private connectivity, transit architectures, and zero\-trust segmentation (e.g., illumio).


container platform \& gitops

* operate, upgrade, and extend production kubernetes and openshift (rosa) clusters at enterprise scale, including cluster lifecycle automation, drift detection, and progressive delivery patterns.
* maintain gitops\-based delivery with argo cd, helm, and kustomize, managing code and configuration in bitbucket (preferred) or github with a defined branching strategy, pull request review, and release tagging; build golden paths and self\-service capabilities, and advise application teams on containerization, workload placement, and resource governance.


data \& integration platform enablement

* automate provisioning and operations for oracle autonomous data warehouse (connectivity, wallet and secret management, scaling, backup posture), and support confluent kafka and mulesoft cloudhub 2\.0 with infrastructure, networking, and deployment automation.
* work with data \& analytics partners to make environment promotion for data and analytics artifacts as repeatable as application delivery using iac.


reliability, observability \& finops

* instrument platforms with metrics, logs, and traces; define slos and actionable alerting, drive down alert noise, contribute to incident response and blameless postmortems, and automate remediation of recurring failure modes.
* deliver cost visibility and optimization: tagging and showback, rightsizing, commitment management (reserved instances / savings plans), storage lifecycle policy, and capacity planning across cloud and data platforms.


technical leadership \& delivery

* serve as a subject matter expert alongside business, application, and infrastructure teams; gather requirements, estimate effort from inception to delivery, and complete work within scope, priority, timeline, and budget, running smaller efforts independently and contributing to larger programs with limited oversight.
* produce design specifications, architecture diagrams, and operational runbooks and keep them current; mentor less experienced engineers, conduct design and code reviews, manage vendor escalations and product evaluations, and sustain a culture of quality, innovation, and disciplined experimentation.

**cls generic candidate profile**


successful candidates should possess knowledge, experience, and demonstrate leadership skills as follows: generally, a professional position with specific knowledge in a discipline (e.g., accounting, human resources, information resources). college degree and/or relevant experience typically required.

**specific candidate profile**


education


* ba/bs in computer science, computer engineering, information systems, or a related technical discipline preferred; equivalent hands\-on professional experience accepted in lieu of a degree.

  

certifications


* associate or professional level aws or azur
* cka/ckad or ex280
* terraform associate or a vendor ai/ml certification


experience

* 7\+ years in an it engineering, administration, or architecture role, including 5\+ years of hands\-on automation and infrastructure as code.
* 4\+ years designing and operating production workloads in at least one major public cloud (aws or azure preferred), working exposure to a second (oci).
* 3\+ years supporting production kubernetes, with openshift or rosa strongly preferred
* 3\+ years writing production\-grade code in python (preferred) or a comparable language
* automating large\-scale, multi\-environment infrastructure estates; enterprise application deployment, maintenance, and administration; production support including occasional on\-call participation; and infrastructure as code and configuration management in a regulated or audited enterprise environment.


preferred experience

* multi\-cloud operations spanning aws, azure, and oci rather than a single provider, and managed openshift (rosa or aro) at scale including cluster upgrades and day\-2 operations.
* oracle adw, microsoft fabric, or comparable managed data platforms; platform engineering or internal developer platform work (backstage or equivalent); hospitality, timeshare, travel, or another distributed multi\-site enterprise environment.
* ai and emerging technology ("plus")


	+ hands\-on use of ai coding assistants and agentic development tools (claude code, github copilot) in a team setting, including the review and testing practices that make ai\-generated code safe to ship.
	+ building services or internal tooling against llm apis (anthropic claude, azure ai foundry, amazon bedrock), including prompt design, structured outputs, and tool calling.
	+ evaluation and lifecycle discipline for ai systems: eval harnesses, prompt and model versioning, and drift monitoring.
	+ aiops and ai governance: llm\-assisted incident triage, data classification, acceptable use, audit evidence, and cost control.

**skills \& attributes**

* **analytical \& strategic thinking**
* solves systemic problems through automation rather than addressing issues ticket by ticket.
* troubleshoots systematically and exercises sound judgment under pressure.
* weighs trade\-offs across cost, reliability, security, and speed and explains the rationale clearly.
* **technical**
* uses terraform and ansible at a module and collection authoring level.
* applies knowledge of kubernetes and openshift workloads, operators, networking, storage, rbac, and admission control.
* supports gitops and continuous delivery using argo cd, helm, kustomize, tekton, and/or azure devops pipelines.
* demonstrates cloud and platform fundamentals, including networking, identity and federation, secrets management, key management, linux, windows server, vmware, rest apis, provider sdks, observability, and slo practices.
* applies ai working knowledge of ai/llm concepts, including prompting, context management, retrieval, tool calling, evaluation, and token/cost awareness.
* **project management**
* organizes work across priorities, timelines, dependencies, and competing demands.

* **interpersonal \& leadership**
* communicates complex technical concepts clearly to engineers and non\-technical stakeholders, both verbally and in writing.
* builds trust across global technology, business partners, vendors, and cross\-functional teams.
* gives and receives direct feedback constructively.
* demonstrates strong presentation and diagramming skills.
* **additional attributes**
* operates effectively with ambiguity and limited oversight.
* stays current with a fast\-moving technology landscape.

ruby on rails · java · react · postgresql · node.js · microservices · metabase · rest/graphql apis · gcp · git · ci/cd · ai\-assisted development

title: Junior Full Stack Engineer
description:
cortrucent technologies is seeking a junior full stack developer to help build and maintain healthcare technology platforms used by hospital systems and their patients, including a clinical document exchange and eligibility application and a companion patient\-facing portal, all handling phi under hipaa. you will write, test, and ship production code across the full stack: python backend services, modern javascript front ends, and hand\-written sql. you will use ai coding assistants as part of the daily workflow, with full responsibility for reviewing, correcting, and defending every line before it reaches a pull request. this is a hands\-on role with structured onboarding, direct mentorship from senior engineers, and real ownership from day one. the right candidate has 1 to 3 years of professional experience (or equivalent ability), codes well, tests as a habit, and treats security and phi handling as engineering fundamentals rather than someone else's job. if you want to grow fast on a small, senior team where your work directly reaches patients and clinical staff, we want to hear from you.


### **description**


**employment type: full\-time**

**level: junior (1\-3 years)**

**location: onsite \- 23 harker ave, berlin, nj 08009**

**reports to: cio engineering \& data**

**about cortrucent**
====================


at cortrucent, we do more than safeguard businesses, we empower them to thrive through it innovation, cybersecurity, and business transformation.

**our vision**
==============


to be the most trusted technology partner for organizations that take their security, their operations, and their future seriously.

**our mission \- securing business. enabling growth.**
======================================================


our mission is to be the partner organizations rely on for security, it, and building ai\-driven solutions, delivering on one promise every day: securing business. enabling growth.

**our values \- trust \| transparency \| teamwork**
===================================================

* trust \- we earn it through competence, discretion, and doing what we say we will do. our clients hand us their most critical systems, and we treat that responsibility accordingly.
* transparency \- we communicate openly about progress, pricing, and problems. bad news travels fast here, and surfacing issues early is rewarded, never punished.
* teamwork \- we share knowledge, review each other's work, and succeed together. no silos, no territory, no heroes working alone.

**about the role**
==================


cortrucent is seeking a junior full stack developer. we build and maintain healthcare technology platforms used by hospital systems and their patients, a clinical document exchange and eligibility application, and a companion patient\-facing portal. both handle protected health information under hipaa and integrate with payer, clearinghouse, and provider systems.

  

this is a hands\-on role for someone early in their career who codes well and uses ai development tools well. you'll write, review, test, and ship application code, some of it drafted by ai coding assistants, all of it your responsibility to understand, verify, and defend in code review. we are explicitly not looking for someone who accepts generated code at face value.




you will work closely with senior engineers, with structured onboarding and real ownership.

**what you’ll do**
==================

**core development**
--------------------

* build and modify api endpoints and backend service logic in python.
* write and modify front\-end components and screens, including work in large existing files.
* write and tune sql and author schema changes by hand.

**quality \& testing**
----------------------

* write tests alongside your code and treat test coverage as part of the work rather than an afterthought.
* reproduce and fix defects reported by clients and internal qa.

**security \& compliance**
--------------------------

* apply role\-based authorization correctly on everything you touch — getting this wrong is a security defect, not a style issue.
* handle phi correctly in code: logging, exception handling, audit trails, file paths, and error messages.

**tooling, documentation \& continuous improvement**
----------------------------------------------------

* use ai coding assistants to move faster, then review, correct, and test the output before it reaches a pull request.
* document what you build and write down the sharp edges nobody has captured yet.

**what you bring**
==================

* 1\-3 years professional expereince or equivalent abilities
* python proficiency, including experience with a web framework and comfort reading unfamiliar code.
* sql databases (sql server, postgresql, mysql, or similar): joins, aggregation, indexes, transactions, and the ability to write ddl by hand.
* experience with an orm, and an understanding of what it's actually doing to the database underneath.
* modern javascript and a component\-based front\-end framework. comfort reading a large component and making a surgical change without proposing to rewrite it.
* working knowledge of html and css.
* automated testing experience in at least one language, and a genuine habit of writing tests alongside code.
* git fluency \- branching, merging, resolving conflicts, and participating in pull request review.
* demonstrated use of ai coding assistants in real projects, with the judgment to recognize when generated code is wrong, insecure, over\-engineered, or inconsistent with surrounding conventions.
* command\-line comfort, and the ability to work through an involved local environment setup without losing a week to it.
* clear written communication — you can describe a bug, a fix, and a tradeoff in plain language, and ask a precise question when stuck.
* passion for technology \& security
* strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills
* valid driver's license and reliable transportation
* authorized to work in the u.s. without sponsorship — current or future.

**bonus points for**
--------------------

* experience in a hipaa\-regulated or otherwise compliance\-heavy engineering environment.
* familiarity with healthcare concepts — eligibility, charity care, medical assistance programs, appeals, consent and signature workflows, or revenue cycle generally.
* experience with containerized local development.
* exposure to oauth2 / enterprise sso and role\-based access control.
* experience working within a ci/cd pipeline and automated quality gates.
* certifications like security\+, isc2 cc, csslp, devsecops certs
* consulting or service provider background.
* familiarity with compliance \& security frameworks (soc 2, hipaa, nist, iso, hitrust, etc.)

**who you are**
===============


technical skill matters, and so does the kind of teammate you are. we're a small group building things that patients and clinical staff rely on, and the work goes better when people enjoy working together. we'd love to hear from someone who is:




* a good teammate. you share credit, assume good intent, and treat the codebase as something the team owns together.
* open to feedback. you see code review as a chance to learn, and you're comfortable when a colleague spots something you missed — that's the system working.
* comfortable asking questions. nobody expects you to know everything, especially early on. saying “i'm not sure — can you walk me through this?” is genuinely welcome here.
* happy to share what you know. you explain things patiently, write down what you learn, and make things a little easier for whoever comes next.
* dependable. you follow through, and you give people a heads\-up when something is taking longer than expected.
* comfortable working across roles. you'll talk with clinical and operations staff, client contacts, and project leads, and you can adjust how you explain things depending on who's listening.
* level\-headed. production issues and client escalations come with the territory. we value people who stay calm, focus on the fix, and work the problem as a team.
* curious. about the code, about the healthcare side of things, and about why the system is built the way it is.




if some of these come more naturally to you than others, that's fine, we're looking for the overall shape, not a perfect score.

**how we expect you to use ai tools**
=====================================


this is a real part of the job, so we're explicit about it:




* you own the output. “the assistant wrote it” is not an explanation in code review.
* you verify against our codebase, not against general practice. our conventions are specific and deliberate, and generated code has to match them.
* you protect phi absolutely. no protected health information, credentials, or client\-identifying production data goes into any ai tool outside approved, contractually covered channels. no exceptions, no judgment calls.
* you use it to learn, not to skip learning. we expect you to be a meaningfully stronger engineer at twelve months than at day one, and ai assistance should accelerate that rather than substitute for it.

**schedule and availability**
=============================

* willingness to work occasionally on weekends and holidays based on workload.
* availability for after\-hours on\-call support rotation as required.
* meets deadlines and milestones set by leadership, with proactive communication when risks or blockers arise.
* extreme attention to detail and a commitment to doing the work the right way the first time, no quick patches, no temporary fixes left in place, and no shortcuts that create future technical debt.

**abilities \& qualities**
==========================

* client\-focused \& adaptable — maintains client context, empathy, and urgency in every engagement; adapts quickly to changing priorities and client needs; goes above and beyond to deliver exceptional experiences.
* clear \& collaborative communicator — communicates clearly and confidently with clients and teammates; builds positive relationships and works well within a team.
* hands\-on doer — balances structured process with practical, hands\-on execution.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**who we are**


at orthofi, we're not just another player in the orthodontic industry – we're the driving force that helps orthodontists launch more smiles while ensuring top\-tier patient care. our tech\-savvy solutions are the secret sauce that empowers orthodontic practices across the united states. with a track record of supporting over 2,000 practices, and in partnership with orthobanc, we've unlocked access to quality, affordable orthodontic care for a whopping 3\.2 million patients and counting!

  

picture this: our cutting\-edge patient acquisition software combined with our expert revenue cycle management solutions propels practices to achieve jaw\-dropping 13% year\-over\-year growth. plus, when it comes to patient and insurance billing, our collection results leave competitors in the dust.

  

behind our mission is a dynamic team of around 300 passionate individuals. our headquarters is based in denver, co, with employees spread across several states. join us in our quest to transform the orthodontic landscape – where innovation meets dedication, and starting more smiles are just the beginning.

  

our purpose is to radically improve the way patients access and pay for quality elective care. diversity, equity, and inclusion (dei) ensures we can fulfill our purpose by creating a better, more equitable and inclusive workplace for our community members and healthcare experience for all.

  

by focusing on dei, we are working towards our mission of *connecting more patients with quality orthodontic and dental care and helping make treatment accessible to over 1 million patients a year by 2025*. equity is core to our mission to serve patients, and dei is embedded in our core values, especially “seek diversity,” and “do what’s right.”"

  

orthofi is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. we are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status.

  

roles based outside of our denver office can sit in any of the following states: colorado, florida, georgia, louisiana, north carolina, ohio, tennessee, and texas. please only apply if you are able to live and work full\-time in one of the states listed above.

 **the opportunity**


at orthofi, we are looking for a talented, full stack senior software engineer to drive technical execution and tackle complex challenges in our **insurance** domain. this role requires a deep understanding of building scalable, modern applications while navigating the complexities of an industry with strict regulations, high data integrity requirements, and intricate workflows.


as a senior engineer, you will serve as a critical technical problem\-solver— who takes extreme ownership of building scalable, highly reliable software systems in an agile environment. in this role, you will navigate the technical and regulatory complexities of insurance eligibility, claims processing, and remittance workflows. you will work closely with domain experts, product managers, and engineering peers to modernize legacy systems, design service\-based architectures, and deliver high\-impact software.


success in this role is measured by your ability to evolve our core systems with a relentless focus on business roi and long\-term technical health. beyond writing exceptional code, you will champion the integration and adoption of ai tools, agentic workflows, and other efficiency drivers to fundamentally reshape how we develop software.

**what you will do**
--------------------


as a senior software engineer your core responsibilities include:

* **design \& system evolution:** decompose complex business scenarios into clean, service\-based architectures and distributed systems. modernize legacy platforms with a focus on simplicity, maintainability, and long\-term roi.
* **domain alignment:** translate complex orthodontic insurance rules (claims, eligibility, remittance) into clean, high\-performing technical solutions.
* **epic ownership:** own the delivery of epics end\-to\-end, actively managing risks, dependencies, and team\-level dora kpis while ensuring system performance and delivery reliability.
* **full\-stack development:** write clean, robust, and maintainable code across the stack, leveraging modern javascript frameworks (react) on the frontend and .net core/.net framework on the backend.
* **ai\-assisted engineering:** champion responsible, ai\-assisted development. actively integrate ai tools (e.g., claude, github copilot) to automate design, test generation, and code reviews, and build agentic workflows to drive team efficiency.
* **software design \& quality:** set rigorous standards for code quality through constructive code reviews, comprehensive automated testing (including ai\-driven test suites), and continuous integration/delivery (ci/cd).
* **technical leadership \& mentorship:** guide junior and mid\-level engineers on software design patterns, debug cross\-module issues, and act as a professional stakeholder manager who can navigate technical disagreements constructively ("disagree and commit").

**what you will bring**

**education \& core experience**

* **education:** 4\-year bachelor’s degree in a stem (science, technology, engineering, mathematics) major or a master's degree in technology or computer science or related field.
* **professional experience:** 10\+ years of professional software development experience, with a minimum of 4\+ years in a senior software engineer role (or equivalent).

### **core technical expertise**

* **backend ecosystem:** strong, hands\-on experience with the .net ecosystem (.net core / .net framework) and robust relational database design using sql server (including query optimization).
* **frontend ecosystem:** extensive experience building highly responsive, scalable user interfaces using modern javascript frameworks—specifically **react and/or angular (required)**.
* **architecture \& design:** practical experience applying **domain\-driven design (ddd)** principles and building service\-based or distributed architectures.
* **cloud \& devops:** strong proficiency with aws services (or other major cloud architectures), ci/cd pipelines and infrastructure provisioning.
* **batch \& data processing:** familiarity with high\-volume batch processing, background automated jobs, and handling complex data streams.

### **preferred technical pluses**

* experience with infrastructure as code (iac) using terraform.
* familiarity with event\-driven architectures and system monitoring/apm tools (e.g., datadog).
* prior domain knowledge in orthodontic/dental billing, medical insurance, or healthcare fintech.
* experience designing and querying apis with graphql.
* experience with search and analytics engines, specifically elasticsearch.

### **ai \& automation mindset**

* demonstrated experience or active experimentation leveraging modern ai coding assistants (e.g., cursor, claude, github copilot) to optimize development velocity.
* familiarity with gen ai and enterprise agentic workflows or utilizing model context protocols (mcps) to automate engineering workflows.
* experience with automated testing frameworks (such as playwright or equivalent) driven by ai agents.

**how you will work**
---------------------

* **engineering persona:** *the site manager.* you focus on building highly structured systems and show extreme ownership and systems thinking over your domain’s codebase.
* **delivery:** you roadmap large tracks of work, identify non\-functional requirements (nfrs) for epics, and maintain high execution integrity without needing close supervision.
* **problem solving:** you define the scope of open\-ended, ambiguous problems and independently offer thoughtful, data\-driven analysis to drive continuous process improvement.

title: Azure PostgresSQL DBA
description:
**company description**  

captech is a technology consulting firm dedicated to helping clients achieve their business objectives through innovative technology solutions. with a commitment to excellence and collaboration, captech partners with leading companies to deliver digital transformation, software development, and technology consulting services.

  


**job description**  

azure postgresql database administrators at captech own the health, performance, and security of the data platforms our clients depend on every day. this is a consulting role, so you will work alongside engineers, architects, analysts, and client stakeholders to stabilize what exists today and design what comes next. the work is hands\-on and cloud\-first.


we are looking for a dba who thinks like an engineer. you should be comfortable owning production incidents, but equally comfortable eliminating the conditions that caused them through automation, monitoring, and better design.


responsibilities:

* administer postgresql environments across development, test, and production, including azure database for postgresql flexible server and self\-managed instances on azure virtual machines or aks.
* own performance tuning end to end: analyze execution plans, design indexing and partitioning strategies, tune autovacuum and server parameters, and resolve bloat, lock contention, and connection saturation.
* design and test high availability and disaster recovery configurations, including read replicas, zone\-redundant deployments, point\-in\-time restore, and documented failover runbooks with defined rpo and rto targets.
* automate provisioning and configuration of database infrastructure using terraform or bicep, and deliver schema changes through azure pipelines or github actions with tools such as flyway or liquibase.
* implement database security and compliance controls, including microsoft entra id authentication, role and privilege design, row\-level security, encryption at rest and in transit, private endpoints, and key vault secret rotation.
* build observability into the data tier with azure monitor, log analytics, and query store, and define the alerting thresholds that catch problems before clients notice them.
* manage capacity and cost, right\-sizing compute and storage tiers and advising clients on reserved capacity and scaling strategy.
* partner with application engineers on data modeling, query design, and connection pooling through pgbouncer or the built\-in pooler.
* produce runbooks, standards, and knowledge transfer materials that leave client teams able to operate the platform after the engagement ends.
* participate in an on\-call rotation for production support where the engagement requires it.

  


**qualifications*** five or more years administering postgresql in production, including tuning, upgrades, backup and recovery, replication, and incident response.
* two or more years working in microsoft azure, with hands\-on experience running azure database for postgresql flexible server.
* strong sql and pl/pgsql skills, with fluency in explain analyze, pg\_stat\_statements, and the rest of the postgresql diagnostic toolkit.
* working knowledge of infrastructure as code with terraform, bicep, or arm templates, and ci/cd pipelines on git\-based version control.
* scripting proficiency in python, bash, or powershell for operational automation.
* understanding of azure networking and identity fundamentals, including virtual networks, private endpoints, key vault, and microsoft entra id.
* experience supporting applications through a full sdlc using agile or waterfall methodologies.
* excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to explain risk and tradeoffs directly to client stakeholders.
* consulting experience and familiarity with regulated environments such as financial services, healthcare, or the public sector are preferred.
* azure certifications such as az\-104 or az\-305 are a plus.

  


**additional information**  

we want everyone at captech to be able to envision a lasting and rewarding career here, which is why we offer a variety of career paths based on your skills and passions. you decide where and how you want to develop, and we help get you there with customizable career progression and a comprehensive benefits package to support you along the way. alongside our suite of traditional benefits encompassing generous pto, health coverage, disability insurance, paid family leave and more, we’ve launched extended benefits to help meet our employees’ needs.

* learning \& development – programs offering certification and tuition support, digital on\-demand learning courses, mentorship, and skill development paths
* modern health –a mental health and well\-being platform that provides 1:1 care, group support sessions, and self\-serve resources to support employees and their families through life’s ups and downs
* carrot fertility –inclusive fertility and family\-forming coverage for all paths to parenthood – including adoption, surrogacy, fertility treatments, pregnancy, and more – and opportunities for employer\-sponsored funds to help pay for care
* fringe –a company paid stipend program for personalized lifestyle benefits, allowing employees to choose benefits that matter most to them – ranging from vendors like netflix, spotify, and grubhub to services like student loan repayment, travel, fitness, and more
* employee resource groups – employee\-led committees that embrace and incorporate diversity and inclusion into our day\-to\-day operations
* philanthropic partnerships – opportunities to engage in partnerships and pro\-bono projects that support our communities.
* 401(k) matching – generous matching and no vesting period to help you continue to build financial wellness


captech is committed to providing a flexible work environment and helping our employees achieve a work\-life balance that suits their individual needs. employees must be available to work onsite in a client location or a captech office as requested. we allow captech employees to work remotely when compatible with captech and client needs.


captech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a culture of equality, inclusion and fairness — each foundational to our core values. we strive to create a diverse environment where each employee is encouraged to bring their unique ideas, backgrounds and experiences to the workplace. as part of this commitment, captech will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. if reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.


captech supports equal pay for all. in addition, in the state of virginia, we are committed to equal pay for all in accordance with the virginia transparency law. compensation for this role will be commensurate with the candidate’s skills, total relevant experience, job level, and geographic location. the base pay range for this role is: $140,000\-$200,000\.

we have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level.
  

  

as a software engineer iii at jpmorganchase within the connected commerce \- proprietary wallets team, you serve as a seasoned member of an agile team to design and deliver trusted market\-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. you are responsible for carrying out critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives.
  

  

**job responsibilities*** executes software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or breakdown technical problems
* creates secure and high\-quality production code and maintains algorithms that run synchronously with appropriate systems
* leverages enterprise\-authorized ai coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness.
* applies knowledge of tools within the software development life cycle toolchain, including enterprise\-authorized ai\-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.
* produces architecture and design artifacts for complex applications while being accountable for ensuring design constraints are met by software code development
* gathers, analyzes, synthesizes, and develops visualizations and reporting from large, diverse data sets in service of continuous improvement of software applications and systems
* proactively identifies hidden problems and patterns in data and uses these insights to drive improvements to coding hygiene and system architecture

**required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**
* formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3\+ years applied experience
* hands\-on practical experience in system design, application development, testing, and operational stability
* writes secure and high\-quality code using the syntax of at least one programming language with limited guidance \- java / spring boot / microservices / restapis
* experience in developing, debugging, and maintaining code in a large corporate environment with one or more modern programming languages and database querying languages
* hands\-on experience using enterprise\-authorized ai\-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine ai\-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security.

* overall knowledge of the software development life cycle
* solid understanding of agile methodologies such as ci/cd, application resiliency, and security
